Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as Warsh keeps inflation fight front and centre
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed the central bank's focus on fighting inflation, raising expectations for a September rate hike. The Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq, and tech stocks like Nvidia all declined amid mixed corporate earnings and economic data.

Markets.title: Gap shares surge 24% after Old Navy leadership shake-up, profit forecast raised
Markets.summary: Gap shares surged up to 24.1% after the company appointed Michael Francis as the new CEO of Old Navy and raised its annual profit forecast. Investors responded positively to the leadership change aimed at reversing falling sales at the retailer's largest brand.

Markets.title: Sebi plans bigger institutional role in public offers by small firms, sources say
Markets.summary: India's market regulator is considering new rules for small business public offerings, including quotas for institutional investors. The proposed changes also involve raising listing size limits and profit requirements to improve governance and investor protection.

Markets.title: Hero MotoCorp buys Rs 1,758 crore Ather Energy stake in block deal
Markets.summary: Hero MotoCorp acquired 1.18 crore shares of Ather Energy from the Government of Singapore for Rs 1,758 crore. This block deal increases Hero MotoCorp's stake in the electric vehicle maker to approximately 32.8 percent.

Markets.title: Jackson Hole: Will Kevin Warsh's inflation warning put Nifty under pressure on Monday?
Markets.summary: The Nifty faces potential pressure on Monday following hawkish inflation comments from US Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole. Additionally, elevated US bond yields, a stronger dollar, and rising crude oil prices threaten foreign institutional flows into the Indian stock market.

Markets.title: Blackstone to sell up to 25% stake worth Rs 11,988 crore in Knowledge Realty Trust
Markets.summary: Blackstone is selling up to a 25.03% stake in Knowledge Realty Trust worth Rs 11,988 crore through an offer for sale on the BSE and NSE. The two-day share sale is being conducted to comply with regulatory public unitholding requirements.

Geo-Political.title: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
Geo-Political.summary: Dramatic footage of deadly flash floods in Tibet is being hidden from the public inside China. Consequently, very little information is known about the victims in the region.

Geo-Political.title: US and Venezuela reach 'historic' oil deal, Trump says
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Venezuela have reached an agreement granting the US majority control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves. President Trump described the accord as a historic deal.

Geo-Political.title: Landlady to 9/11 hijackers reveals their links to alleged Saudi spy
Geo-Political.summary: The former landlady of two al-Qaeda 9/11 hijackers spoke to the BBC for the first time about their connections to an alleged Saudi spy. This revelation provides new insight into the background of the operatives who carried out the September 11 attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
Geo-Political.summary: Mourners have gathered outside the palace in Norway to remember the late King Harald. Following his death, his son has ascended the throne as King Haakon VIII and adopted the family motto "all for Norway."

Geo-Political.title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
Geo-Political.summary: Oslo Mayor Anne Lindboe canceled her scheduled Friday wedding ceremony. The cancellation occurred following the death of Norway's king.

Geo-Political.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
Geo-Political.summary: Right-wing British commentator Milo Yiannopoulos was detained by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Yiannopoulos is a U.S. resident who has previously expressed support for Donald Trump and ICE agents.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator tested asking ChatGPT for WordPress SaaS course recommendations and found their own course listed as the top result without paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI content. Additionally, the platform provides tools for creators to share and monetize their digital work.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth narrows to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in July from 8.8% in June due to a dip in mining. Despite this moderation, overall growth remained strong, driven by the manufacturing and capital goods sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Algeria becomes India's 3rd-largest source of LPG in August amid supply crunch
Data & Insights.summary: Algeria supplied 110,711 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to India in August, according to Kpler data. This volume made Algeria India's third-largest source of LPG imports during a period of supply constraints.

Data & Insights.title: Not just the farmer, PSBs may soon fund entire farm value chains
Data & Insights.summary: Public sector banks may soon shift from lending to individual farmers to funding entire agricultural value chains under a new government proposal. This cluster-based plan will connect farmers and Farmer Producer Organizations with processors, storage facilities, and logistics businesses.

Data & Insights.title: India, Canada seek to deepen economic cooperation beyond trade through investment, finance and capital markets
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada held their inaugural Economic and Financial Dialogue to strengthen ties beyond traditional trade. Their finance ministers discussed domestic macroeconomic stability, financial integration, and cooperation on critical minerals.

Data & Insights.title: Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole Speech: 5 key things markets expect to hear from new Fed chief on 28 August
Data & Insights.summary: Markets are waiting for Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech to clarify his stance on underlying inflation and monetary policy decisions. Although his past comments suggest a cautious approach to rate increases, investors remain uncertain because his specific methods for measuring inflation are still unclear.

Data & Insights.title: India-Japan ties gain momentum after Piyush Goyal’s Japan visit
Data & Insights.summary: Piyush Goyal visited Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka to accelerate Japanese investment in India. His trip focused on strengthening industrial partnerships and building resilient supply chains.

India.title: Spider-Man, Motu-Patlu, And A Greek Drama: BJP Casts Insta Meme Net For Gen-Z Attention
India.summary: The BJP is using pop culture references and Gen-Z slang in its social media strategy to connect with younger Indian voters. A recent meme-based motivational speech posted by the party highlights this renewed approach.

India.title: No Update On Group Of 77 Pilgrims Of Isha Foundation Missing In Tibet
India.summary: A 77-member group of pilgrims organized by the Isha Foundation remains out of contact in Tibet. Authorities have provided no new updates regarding the missing travelers.

India.title: Himanta Sarma Says 6 Youths From Assam Missing In Nepal's Devastating Flood
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma announced that six youths from Assam are missing following severe floods in Nepal. Authorities are currently working to gather more information regarding their status and safety.

India.title: Ankit Balyan Murder: Haryanvi Singer's Wife Threatens Self-Immolation In 4-Day Ultimatum To Cops
India.summary: Haryanvi singer Ankit Balyan was shot dead outside a gym in Shamli by four unidentified attackers on motorcycles. Following his murder, his wife gave police a four-day ultimatum to make arrests and threatened self-immolation if justice is not served.

India.title: US Trade Deal Takes Centre Stage At Shivraj Chouhan's Punjab Speech
India.summary: Shivraj Chouhan stated that Prime Minister Narendra Modi refused to sign any trade deal with the United States that harms Indian farmers. He emphasized that Modi prioritized the welfare of Indian agriculturalists in international trade negotiations.

India.title: "Krishna Consciousness Can Make World Better": Mohan Bhagwat At New York
India.summary: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat addressed devotees at a temple in New York. He stated that Krishna consciousness can unite people and resolve global conflicts.

General.title: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'
General.summary: Ninety-seven-year-old Guna Maya Bohara survived flash floods in Nepal. She was rescued from the floodwaters using an excavator.

General.title: Man dies and at least six injured after sign falls at Christian festival
General.summary: A 41-year-old man died and at least six others were injured after a sign fell at the Big Church Festival in West Sussex. Police are currently investigating the incident at the event near Steyning.

General.title: 'It's destroying our town': Residents tell of concern after violent incidents near Middlesbrough
General.summary: Residents living near Middlesbrough have expressed deep concern to the BBC following a recent series of violent incidents in their area. They report that this spate of violence is having a devastating impact on their town.
